_about: Homer in English, translator recorded per title. Verse: George Chapman (Iliads 1611, Odysseys and the shorter poems 1614-16), Alexander Pope (Iliad 1715-20, ed. Buckley; Odyssey 1725-26, with Broome and Fenton), William Cowper (Iliad and Odyssey, blank verse, 1791; Iliad here in Southey's edition), the Earl of Derby (Iliad, blank verse, 1864), William Cullen Bryant (Iliad 1870, Odyssey 1871-72, blank verse; raw IA OCR). Prose: T. A. Buckley (Iliad, Bohn, 1851) and Samuel Butler's unrevised Odyssey (1900). Butler's Iliad is already in the build from Perseus (iliad-butler) and is not refetched. The build's odyssey-eng4 is Butler REVISED by Power and Nagy (a modern revision), so the plain 1900 Butler Odyssey is held here as the text of record. Lang-Leaf-Myers Iliad and Butcher-Lang Odyssey live on the Lang shelf (lane D); Dryden's Homer on the Dryden shelf (lane C); Evelyn-White's Homeric Hymns and Epigrams in hesiod-evelyn-white. All cross-referenced, none refetched. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row). Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.
